definitions.explanation: A small building or enclosure for keeping and raising animals. Commonly associated with small animals kept at Japanese elementary schools.

examples.japanese: {飼育小屋|しいくごや}でうさぎを{飼|か}っている。
examples.english: We keep rabbits in the animal pen.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{飼育小屋|しいくごや}には{鶏|にわとり}がいた。
examples.english: There were chickens in the elementary school's animal shed.

examples.japanese: {当番|とうばん}の{日|ひ}は{朝|あさ}{早|はや}く{学校|がっこう}に{来|き}て、{飼育小屋|しいくごや}の{掃除|そうじ}と{餌|えさ}やりをしなければならなかった。
examples.english: On duty days, I had to come to school early in the morning to clean the animal shed and feed the animals.

notes:
A compound of {飼育|しいく} (raising/breeding animals) and {小屋|こや} (hut/shed). Many Japanese elementary schools have a {飼育小屋|しいくごや} where students take turns caring for small animals like rabbits, chickens, or guinea pigs as part of their education in responsibility and life science.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飼育小屋|しいくごや}の{掃除|そうじ} — cleaning the animal shed
- {飼育小屋|しいくごや}の{当番|とうばん} — animal shed duty
- {飼育小屋|しいくごや}を{建|た}てる — to build an animal pen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小屋|こや} — hut; shed (general term for a small structure)
- {鶏小屋|とりごや} — chicken coop (specifically for chickens)
- {犬小屋|いぬごや} — doghouse
- {牛舎|ぎゅうしゃ} — cattle barn (larger, for livestock farming)
